test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Afternoon show of a film or play
solution: The correct answer is '**Matinee**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Matinee**'. • It means 'an afternoon performance of a play, film, etc. (किसी नाटक, फ़िल्‍म आदि का अपराह्नकालीन प्रदर्शन)'. • *Example: To save a couple of dollars, try going to a **matinee** showing.* **Correct Answer:**__ *Matinee.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Spectacle**: something that is impressive or shocking to look at. (प्रभावशाली या विक्षोभकारी दृश्‍य; नज़ारा) • **Performance**: the act of performing something in front of an audience; something that you perform. (दर्शकों के सामने कार्यक्रम प्रस्‍तुत करने की क्रिया; कार्यक्रम) • **Movie**: a cinema film. (एक सिनेमा फिल्म) 234:T601, The erroneous part is** 'that it will be causing'.**
